scene: The artisan hands you travel tokens as thanks.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view on an open riverside transit concourse. On the far left sits a red funicular railway car with open doors. In the centre, the bearded elderly player in blue cap and orange cardigan holds his cane and gleaming tokens. To the right, a wooden water taxi idles. On the far right, a neon monorail awaits passengers.
